title: Lake Formation: permissions over the lake

videos.script: Quitanda's curated orders carry a phone number for the delivery driver. {{phone}} The analysts need the orders. They have no business with the phone numbers. IAM cannot tell those two apart, because the phone number is a column inside the file. {{file}} Lake Formation grants on tables, columns and rows instead of files. {{grants}} An engine like Athena asks it before reading, and gets temporary credentials only if the grants allow. {{vending}} You will register a location, grant four columns of five, and label a column as personal data. {{tags}} moto keeps every one of those grants. It enforces none of them, because no engine here ever asks. {{moto}} And you will find the door Lake Formation does not guard. Anyone still allowed to read the bucket reads every column. {{door}} Then you will read the grants back as an audit, and remove the one that should not be there. {{audit}}
